description:
Implement the gap-tracking metadata system that makes dashboard data gaps into actionable signals for the Director Swarm and Feature teams.

**Each metric widget has a dataSource status:**
- **live** — Real data, pipeline connected and working
- **gap** — Metric defined as valuable, but no data pipeline exists yet
- **partial** — Some data available but incomplete

**Implementation:**
- Metric registry: A configuration file (JSON or Go struct) defining every metric across all dashboards with name, dashboard, description, dataSource status, and what's needed to make it live
- GET /api/v1/gaps endpoint: Returns all gap/partial metrics grouped by dashboard, with descriptions of what data pipeline is missing and priority hints
- CLI integration: command-center gaps command for human-readable output (consumed by Director Swarm agents)
- Updating a metric from gap to live should be a single config change

**The recursive feedback loop:**
1. Dashboards designed with ideal metrics → many start as gap
2. Director Swarm checks /api/v1/gaps during heartbeat → sees missing capabilities
3. Director creates backlog proposals to build missing data pipelines
4. Feature team executes → gap flips to live
5. Dashboard becomes more useful → reveals new ideal metrics to add
6. Cycle repeats

**UX treatment for gaps:**
- Gap metrics render beautifully within the dashboard's theme — NOT ugly "N/A" text
- Subtle visual treatment: shimmer effect, "coming soon" glow, or translucent styling that fits the page's specific theme
- Gap widgets still occupy their intended layout position so dashboard composition is visible even before all data is live
- Dashboards can be deployed before all data sources exist — they look aspirational rather than broken

**Initial gap inventory to seed:**
- Mission Control: MRR/ARR hero number, total users across bundles, uptime %, compound intelligence counter, live cross-system activity feed
- Hive: usage frequency per scenario, revenue attribution, maturity timeline, active-work overlay
- Forge: cost per completed item (token spend), contributor leaderboard, per-initiative burndown, predicted completion dates, flow efficiency
- Ledger: LTV per cohort, expansion revenue, net revenue retention, revenue forecasting, dunning success rate, trial-to-paid funnel
- Broadcast: social media followers, post engagement, SEO rankings, funnel step conversion, campaign attribution, email metrics, CAC, content velocity, brand consistency, referral sources
- Panorama: system pulse animation, anomaly/alert indicators, per-domain sparklines
name: command-center-gap-tracking-system
title: Build metric gap tracking infrastructure with /api/v1/gaps endpoint
